description: This file contains utility functions and wrapper creators for handling OpenAI and Codex web search, payload policies, and stream configurations in an AI agent context. It defines types, imports external modules, and provides functions to normalize parameters, create stream wrappers, and manage payloads for AI models.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIRequestCapabilities
methods.description: Resolves the capabilities of an OpenAI model based on its properties, including provider, api, baseUrl, and compatibility.

methods.name: shouldApplyOpenAIAttributionHeaders
methods.description: Determines if attribution headers should be applied based on the model's capabilities.

methods.name: shouldApplyOpenAIServiceTier
methods.description: Checks if the OpenAI response payload policy allows applying a service tier.

methods.name: shouldApplyOpenAIReasoningCompatibility
methods.description: Checks if the model supports OpenAI reasoning payload compatibility.

methods.name: normalizeOpenAIServiceTier
methods.description: Normalizes a string value to a valid OpenAI service tier or returns undefined.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIServiceTier
methods.description: Resolves and validates the OpenAI service tier from extra parameters, with warning on invalid input.

methods.name: normalizeOpenAITextVerbosity
methods.description: Normalizes a string value to a valid OpenAI text verbosity level or returns undefined.

methods.name: resolveOpenAITextVerbosity
methods.description: Resolves and validates the OpenAI text verbosity from extra parameters, with warning on invalid input.

methods.name: normalizeOpenAIFastMode
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a boolean indicating fast mode, or undefined.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIFastMode
methods.description: Resolves and validates the fast mode setting from extra parameters, with warning on invalid input.

methods.name: applyOpenAIFastModePayloadOverrides
methods.description: Overrides payload object with default service tier if applicable and allowed.

methods.name: createOpenAIResponsesContextManagementWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that manages OpenAI response payload policies and stripping.

methods.name: createOpenAIReasoningCompatibilityWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that patches payloads for reasoning compatibility if supported.

methods.name: createOpenAIFastModeWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that applies fast mode settings to payloads for specific models.

methods.name: createOpenAIServiceTierWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that sets a specific service tier in payloads.

methods.name: createOpenAITextVerbosityWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that sets text verbosity in payloads.

methods.name: createCodexNativeWebSearchWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that injects Codex native web search payloads based on activation state.

methods.name: createCodexDefaultTransportWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that sets transport to 'auto' by default.

methods.name: createOpenAIDefaultTransportWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that sets transport to 'auto' and enables WebSocket warmup.

methods.name: createOpenAIAttributionHeadersWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that adds attribution headers if applicable.
